max_msg_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a pstore message; larger messages are truncated.

compress.description: Enable compression of pstore entries before storage.

backend.description: Enable the pstore backend. Set to 'yes' to activate.

mount_path.description: Filesystem path where pstore is mounted.

max_entries.description: Maximum number of pstore entries to retain; older entries are removed when limit is exceeded.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for pstore-related logging: 0 = quiet, up to 3 = very verbose.

keep_keys.description: List of pstore key names to preserve. Keys not in this list may be dropped unless explicitly enabled.

ignore_keys.description: List of pstore key names to explicitly ignore, regardless of other settings.

subsystems.description: List of pstore subsystems to explicitly enable (e.g., 'efi', 'dell_rbu', 'snp'). Each listed subsystem adds a `enable_<subsystem> = true` directive.
